aoyou-snapshot:
[REDACTED_STRUCTURED_CAPTURE_FRAGMENT]
command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || tf_fail UNSUPPORTED_CURL
command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || tf_fail UNSUPPORTED_JQ
for TF_TOOL in base64 pidof readlink tr awk; do command -v "$TF_TOOL" >/dev/null 2>&1 || tf_fail UNSUPPORTED_TOOLS; done
TF_PIDS=$(pidof mihomo 2>/dev/null) || tf_fail ENGINE_NOT_RUNNING
set -- $TF_PIDS
[ "$#" -eq 1 ] || tf_fail AMBIGUOUS_ENGINE
TF_PID=$1
case "$TF_PID" in ""|*[!0-9]*) tf_fail INVALID_PROCESS_ID;; esac
TF_EXE=$(readlink "/proc/$TF_PID/exe" 2>/dev/null) || tf_fail ENGINE_NOT_RUNNING
[ "$TF_EXE" = [REDACTED_ENCODED_OR_IDENTIFIER] ] || tf_fail UNSUPPORTED_ENGINE_PATH
TF_CONFIG=$(tr '\000' '\n' < "/proc/$TF_PID/cmdline" | awk 'p { print; n++; p=0 } $0 == "-f" { p=1 } END { if (n != 1 || p) exit 1 }') || tf_fail [REDACTED_ENCODED_OR_IDENTIFIER]
case "$TF_CONFIG" in [REDACTED_ENCODED_OR_IDENTIFIER]*/runtime.json) ;; *) tf_fail [REDACTED_ENCODED_OR_IDENTIFIER];; esac
TF_GENERATION=${TF_CONFIG#[REDACTED_ENCODED_OR_IDENTIFIER]}
TF_GENERATION=${TF_GENERATION%/runtime.json}
[ "${#TF_GENERATION}" -eq 24 ] || tf_fail [REDACTED_ENCODED_OR_IDENTIFIER]
case "$TF_GENERATION" in *[!0-9a-f]*) tf_fail [REDACTED_ENCODED_OR_IDENTIFIER];; esac
[ -f "$TF_CONFIG" ] || tf_fail [REDACTED_ENCODED_OR_IDENTIFIER]
TF_RESOLVED=$(readlink -f "$TF_CONFIG" 2>/dev/null) || tf_fail UNSAFE_RUNTIME_PATH
[ "$TF_RESOLVED" = "$TF_CONFIG" ] || tf_fail UNSAFE_RUNTIME_PATH
TF_CONTROLLER=$(jq -er '.["external-controller"] | select(type == "string")' "$TF_CONFIG" 2>/dev/null) || tf_fail UNSUPPORTED_CONTROLLER
case "$TF_CONTROLLER" in [REDACTED_IP]:*) TF_PORT=${TF_CONTROLLER#[REDACTED_IP]:};; *) tf_fail UNSUPPORTED_CONTROLLER;; esac
case "$TF_PORT" in ""|*[!0-9]*) tf_fail UNSUPPORTED_CONTROLLER;; esac
[ "$TF_PORT" -ge 1 ] 2>/dev/null && [ "$TF_PORT" -le 65535 ] 2>/dev/null || tf_fail UNSUPPORTED_CONTROLLER
[REDACTED_SENSITIVE_CONTEXT]
tf_request() {
  TF_METHOD=$1; TF_PATH_B64=$2; TF_BODY_B64=$3; TF_OPERATION=$4; TF_FILTER=$5
  TF_PATH=$(printf '%s' "$TF_PATH_B64" | base64 -d 2>/dev/null) || tf_fail INVALID_REQUEST
  TF_BODY_CONFIG=
  if [ -n "$TF_BODY_B64" ]; then
    TF_BODY=$(printf '%s' "$TF_BODY_B64" | base64 -d 2>/dev/null) || tf_fail INVALID_REQUEST
    TF_BODY_CONFIG=$(printf '%s' "$TF_BODY" | jq -Rs . 2>/dev/null) || tf_fail INVALID_REQUEST
  fi
  TF_RESPONSE=$({
    printf 'url = "[REDACTED_URL]"\n' "$TF_CONTROLLER" "$TF_PATH"
[REDACTED_SENSITIVE_CONTEXT]
    printf 'request = "%s"\n' "$TF_METHOD"
    if [ -n "$TF_BODY_B64" ]; then
      printf 'header = "Content-Type: application/json"\n'
      printf 'data = %s\n' "$TF_BODY_CONFIG"
    fi
  } | curl -q --config - --fail --silent --connect-timeout 3 --max-time 8 --max-filesize 1048576 --path-as-is --noproxy '*' 2>/dev/null) || tf_fail HTTP_OR_NETWORK
  [ -n "$TF_RESPONSE" ] || TF_RESPONSE='{}'
  TF_RESULT=$(printf '%s' "$TF_RESPONSE" | jq -ce --arg operation "$TF_OPERATION" "($TF_FILTER) as \$data | {ok:true,operation:\$operation,data:\$data}" 2>/dev/null) || tf_fail INVALID_RESPONSE
  [ -n "$TF_RESULT" ] || tf_fail INVALID_RESPONSE
  printf 'TOPFLOW_AOYOU_V1=%s\n' "$TF_RESULT"
}
tf_request 'GET' 'L3ZlcnNpb24=' '' 'get-version' 'select((.version | type) == "string" and (.version | length) > 0) | {version: .version, meta: (.meta == true)}'
tf_request 'GET' 'L2NvbmZpZ3M=' '' 'get-configs' 'select(.mode == "rule" or .mode == "global" or .mode == "direct") | {mode: .mode}'
[REDACTED_SENSITIVE_CONTEXT]
